headline: Habit Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Create named habits and check them off daily. Track streaks and build lasting routines to support your personal growth.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Habit Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the habit list with daily check-off interface and current streak indicators.
steps.screenshotAlt: Habit Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Create and name custom habits to track
Check off completed habits each day
Track current streaks and personal records
View habit completion history and consistency
tips: Start with just 2-3 habits to avoid overwhelm and build momentum before adding more.
Check in at the same time each day to make the habit review a ritual in itself.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
